historical_references.reference: Bunty was a popular name for boys in Punjab during the late 19th and early 20th century. It is believed to have originated from the nickname 'Bun' given to boys who were plump or round-faced.

Another theory suggests that the name Bunty may have derived from the Hindi word 'bun', which means 'wisdom' or 'intelligence'. This usage of the name is more commonly associated with the 1960s and 1970s, particularly in the context of Bollywood films.

Overall, the name 'Bunty' has taken on a trendy, youthful connotation in modern times.
